This role plays a critical part in building supplier relationships SCOPE OF THE JOB: Internal Coordination with end user to clarify the need Supplier Research, Evaluation and certify >>> issue report Process bidding >>> benchmark Contract Negotiation >>> Frame agreement Supplier Relationship Management Supplier Performance…
